name: manual_e8c02d
claim: A stale local remote-tracking ref from a remote name that no longer exists can make a branch look present on a second remote; resolve it with git remote -v and git ls-remote before concluding where a commit lives.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: a diaz/... tracking ref made two withdrawn commits look pushed to a second remote that is not configured.

rationale: 2026-10-19: a diaz/... tracking ref made two withdrawn commits look pushed to a second remote that is not configured.
